assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone ornamental raster UI asset for the HELLSCRIPT item detail card, dark gothic ARPG, Diablo-IV-like delicate engraved gothic metalwork. Generate exactly ONE asset, no presentation sheet. Output a native transparent PNG with preserved alpha. All surrounding space and all internal empty spaces must be fully transparent. Every visible shape must be flat pure white (#FFFFFF); antialias edges with alpha only, retaining white RGB. Runtime will tint the artwork. Convey engraving and filigree only by shape and transparent cutouts, never shading. Delicate sharp thorn-and-leaf scrollwork, slightly ornate but readable at small size. No colour, grey, gradients, glow, shadow, drop shadow, text, letters, numbers, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, mockup, or extra frame. Crisp antialiased edges. Square 1:1, 1024x1024. ONE top-left corner ornament for a card frame. An L-shaped bracket: two thin straight bars meeting at the top-left corner, ornate filigree flourish of curling thorn vines and a small diamond jewel at the corner point, tapering to fine points along both edges. Anchor the corner junction at (4% width, 4% height), the padded top-left of the canvas; bars run right and down. Keep the entire ornament within the canvas with about 4% padding. The rest is transparent.
